predecessors.name: Kingdom of Iceland
predecessors.text: Iceland, the whole island, as Cliopatria's last Kingdom of Iceland shape (1939)

ledger.x: November 1963: the island of Surtsey rises from the sea.

wars.name: Cod Wars
wars.outcome: Iceland won each dispute by agreement: 12 nmi (settled February-March 1961), 50 nmi (agreement of 8 November 1973) and 200 nmi (agreement of 1 June 1976); 'Each of the disputes ended with an agreement favourable for Iceland.'

certainty.note: An island: its coastline is the frontier; the sea limits (12, 50, 200 nmi) are zones of waters, not land.
